title: One iOS-spring vocabulary — excise the legacy apple-spring bezier
baseNote: The dispatched worktree HEAD is a09c2b6 (the AT-baseline tree), NOT the eaba94f/a563543 the charter was written against. This tree carries FOUR --spring-* presets (smooth/snappy/bouncy/gentle) — there is NO --spring-dock token here (that is an AX.W01 mint absent from this lineage). The wave's CORE INTENT is base-invariant and was executed against the actual tree: excise the apple-spring bezier, converge onto the ONE governed --spring-* vocabulary, re-point every consumer onto its surface-class register, and build the gate. The 'dock register' maps to --spring-snappy (the dock breathes on it via --animate-dock-in: ... var(--spring-snappy); theme.css), the in-tree control register.
